headline: Revenue and margins surge on AI demand; guidance raised
summary_short: Cadence reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1.584 billion, up 24.2% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.33 (+125.4% y/y) and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $2.11, and raised its full-year 2026 revenue and EPS guidance on a record $8.1 billion backlog.
summary_long: Revenue rose 24.2% y/y to $1.584 billion: IP revenue grew over 40% y/y on Star IP demand and a new Intel agreement, Core EDA rose 18% y/y on AI-portfolio adoption, and System Design and Analysis rose 37% y/y aided by Hexagon D&E integration. GAAP operating margin expanded to 28.4% from 19.0%, partly because the year-ago quarter carried a $128.5 million DOJ/BIS contingent-liability charge that did not recur. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.11 vs $1.65. Cash fell to $1.440 billion from $3.001 billion at year-end on a $2.1 billion acquisition outlay. FY2026 guidance was raised to 19% revenue growth, 44.25% non-GAAP operating margin (midpoint), $8.10 non-GAAP EPS, and $2 billion operating cash flow, citing a record $8.1 billion backlog.

drivers.explanation: IP revenue grew over 40% y/y on Star IP portfolio demand, including a significant Intel agreement; Core EDA rose 18% y/y on AI-portfolio demand; System Design and Analysis rose 37% y/y on PCB/advanced-packaging adoption and Hexagon D&E integration.
GAAP operating margin rose to 28.4% from 19.0% partly because the year-ago quarter included a $128.5 million charge tied to the DOJ/BIS legal settlement that did not recur this quarter.
Net income growth reflects both the non-recurring absence of the $128.5 million DOJ/BIS charge and revenue growth (+24.2%) outpacing total cost growth (+9.7%).

Record $8.1 billion backlog and broad-based double-digit growth led Cadence to raise FY2026 guidance to 19% revenue growth, 44.25% non-GAAP operating margin, $8.10 non-GAAP EPS, and $2 billion operating cash flow, all at the midpoint.
